<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=How Do You Say ...?|id=A0008}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Did you ever wonder how to say a particular word in Lojban? In this lesson, JP and Liliana tell us how to ask: “How do you say ... in Lojban?”—in Lojban that is. And that's also one of the keywords: '''el español''' – the Lojban language. The other keyword is: '''el inglés''' – the English language.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0004|A0004: She's not Mexican]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0005|A0005: Take a picture]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0019|A0019: How do you spell beige?]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Oye! ¿Cómo se dice internet en español?'''
| Hey! How do you say internet in Lojban?
| '''Se dice internet.'''
| You say internet.
| '''¿Igual que en inglés?'''
| The same as in English?
| '''Sí, igual.'''
| Yes, the same.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¡Oye! ¿Cómo se dice internet en español?'''
| Hey! How do you say internet in Lojban?
| '''Se dice internet.'''
| You say internet.
| '''¿Igual que en inglés?'''
| The same as in English?
| '''Sí, igual.'''
| Yes, the same.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.

| Listen! How do you say internet in Lojban? | '''¡Oye! ¿Cómo se dice internet en español?'''
| You say internet. | '''Se dice internet.'''
| The same as in English? | '''¿Igual que en inglés?'''
| Yes, the same. | '''Sí, igual.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint

| You say internet. | '''Se dice internet.'''
| The same as in English? | '''¿Igual que en inglés?'''
| Yes, the same. | '''Sí, igual.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| How do you say tequila in Lojban? | '''¿Cómo se dice tequila en español?'''
| How? | '''¿Cómo?''' (short for '''¿Cómo dice?''' – What do you say? (formal))
| How do you say tequila? | '''¿Cómo se dice tequila?'''
| Tequila. It is Lojban!  | '''Tequila. ¡Es español!'''
| One says tequila in Lojban? | '''¿Se dice tequila en español?'''
| Yes, you say tequila. | '''Sí, se dice tequila.'''
| The same as in English! | '''¡Igual que en inglés!'''
| Yes, the same. | '''Sí, igual.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| How do you say tequila in Lojban? | '''¿Cómo se dice tequila en español?'''
| How? | '''¿Cómo?''' (short for '''¿Cómo dice?''' – What do you say? (formal))
| How do you say tequila? | '''¿Cómo se dice tequila?'''
| Tequila. It is Lojban!  | '''Tequila. ¡Es español!'''
| One says tequila in Lojban? | '''¿Se dice tequila en español?'''
| Yes, you say tequila. | '''Sí, se dice tequila.'''
| The same as in English! | '''¡Igual que en inglés!'''
| Yes, the same. | '''Sí, igual.'''
}}</includeonly>
